title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 FEB)
summary: A compilation of feature request ideas submitted by the Business Central community for potential improvements across multiple areas including Copilot and agents, data migration, development, financial management, and various operational modules. The post organizes suggestions by functional area to help prioritize enhancements.
key_points: Copilot and agent enhancements include sales to purchase traceability, improved performance, extensibility of sales order agents, and semantic index integration
Development feature requests focus on multiselect functionality, report extensions, Shopify connector improvements, and CSV buffer capacity increases
Financial management ideas include VAT validation updates, flexible subscription billing, foreign currency adjustments, and enhanced bank reconciliation
General improvements span CRM integration, auto-refresh, Teams integration, page scripting fixes, and better search functionality
Localization and administration features address language support, user profile automation, and AppSource submission processes
features: Sales to Purchase traceability with Copilot

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a community-driven collection of feature improvement suggestions for Business Central
